'''Morninglight''' is a [[wolf]].

== Activities ==
Morninglight is one of the wolves [[Perrin Aybara]] meets in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' and joins him on his hunt of the white stag.
Morninglight is one of the wolves who Hopper uses to ''shift'' to other places and then get Perrin to track through scent. Morninglight is then attacked and killed by [[Slayer]].
